title: Day and Trial Passes: peak-hours access restriction
content:
This document covers the Day and Trial Passes product line: whether use of the pass is restricted to outside peak hours, and the peak-hours window that would apply.

## Per-tier basis

| Tier | Peak-hours restricted | Peak-hours window |
|---|---|---|
| Single Day Pass | No | 00:00-00:00 |
| Three-Day Trial Pass | No | 00:00-00:00 |
| Seven-Day Trial Pass | No | 00:00-00:00 |
| Weekly Visitor Pass | No | 00:00-00:00 |
| Monthly Trial Pass | No | 00:00-00:00 |
| Corporate Guest Pass | No | 00:00-00:00 |

No tier of the Day and Trial Passes product line restricts use to outside peak hours; every tier records a placeholder peak-hours window of 00:00 to 00:00, which takes effect only where a tier's peak-hours restriction is set, and currently none is.
